imprimis5:

What heroes follow the name rather than the individual?

Assuming you mean what I think you do, Legacy and Bunker are the obvious ones, and Ra probably also counts (arguably the sun god is the same person today as 4000 years ago, but certainly the person who picks up the staff and turns into the sun god is different).  The Argent Adept is part of a lineage but they aren't named Argent Adepts, they're Virtuosos of the Void, so presumably AA is his particular name.  And from the Vengeance info we've seen, KNYFE is a codename which could in theory be passed on to other agents after Paige Huntley goes off the farm.

All of the other eleven Environments have a matching card, with the probable exception of the Final Wasteland (that one could be where the Hurricane is happening, but there's no real reason to assume so).

Megalopolis - Surprise Shopping Trip (this one is arguable but the setting is urban and doesn't seem like Rook City).

Ruins of Atlantis - Atlantean Throne Room

Wagner Mars Base - Marsquake

Rook City - Oppressive Smog

Pike Industrial Complex - Giant Mutated Specimen

Realm of Discord - Tendrils of Madness

Tomb of Anubis - Crushing Hallway

The Block - FILTER Agent

Silver Gulch 1883 - Passing Tumbleweed

??? - Hurricane, Main Computer Room

Specific to the Time Cataclysm itself - Rift in Time x2, Fixed Point
